name: NordVPN
logo: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='150' height='150' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><rect width='100' height='100' rx='22' fill='%230f766e'/><path d='M50 22 L75 35 V55 C75 70 50 80 50 80 C50 80 25 70 25 55 V35 Z' fill='%23ffffff' opacity='0.2'/><path d='M50 28 L70 38 V53 C70 65 50 73 50 73 C50 73 30 65 30 53 V38 Z' fill='%23ffffff'/><path d='M50 38 L62 60 L52 60 L50 50 L48 60 L38 60 Z' fill='%230f766e'/></svg>
about: NordVPN is a leading security and privacy solution provider trusted by millions worldwide. Offering high-speed double encryption, strict no-logs policy, malware protection, and over 6,000 servers across 110+ countries.

faqs.question: Does NordVPN have a free trial?
faqs.answer: NordVPN offers a risk-free 30-day money-back guarantee, allowing you to test all premium features with complete protection.

faqs.question: How many devices can I connect simultaneously?
faqs.answer: A single NordVPN account supports up to 10 devices connected at the same time across Windows, macOS, Android, iOS, and Linux.

about: Grammarly is an AI-powered communication assistant that enhances writing clarity, tone, precision, and correctness across web browsers, desktop applications, and mobile devices.

faqs.question: Is Grammarly Premium worth it?
faqs.answer: Yes, Premium unlocks tone adjustments, full sentence rewrites, plagiarism detection, and advanced style improvements essential for professional writing.

faqs.question: Does Hostinger offer a free domain?
faqs.answer: Yes, Hostinger includes a free custom domain name for the first year with Premium, Business, and Cloud hosting packages.

name: Adobe

faqs.question: Can I get Adobe Creative Cloud discounts?
faqs.answer: Yes, verified students and teachers get up to 60% off standard Creative Cloud plan pricing, and business volume licenses offer significant savings.

name: Canva
about: Canva is an intuitive online visual design suite enabling team collaboration, graphic design, social media assets, presentations, brand kits, and video editing without requiring prior design experience.

faqs.question: Is Canva Pro free to test?
faqs.answer: Yes, new users can start a 30-day full feature trial of Canva Pro to test premium brand kits, background removers, and premium stock assets.

name: Envato
logo: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='150' height='150' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><rect width='100' height='100' rx='22' fill='%2384cc16'/><path d='M30 70 C30 30 70 25 70 25 C70 25 75 65 35 75 C32 75 30 73 30 70 Z' fill='%23ffffff'/></svg>
about: Envato is a digital asset marketplace providing millions of creative templates, stock video clips, web themes, royalty-free music tracks, 3D renders, and graphics for developers and creators.

faqs.question: What does Envato Elements subscription include?
faqs.answer: Envato Elements offers unlimited commercial-license downloads of over 15 million creative assets under a single monthly or yearly subscription.
